correctness.rationale: Every component degree is exactly two and the derived normal sequence is 0->O(2)->O(4)^3->N->0 on the open immersion locus. Its degree and global-generation bound leave only (5,5) and (4,6); Serre-dual cohomology identifies h0(N(-6))=3-rank(W). Rank at least two is equivalent to avoiding simultaneous derivative zeros. A Plücker-coordinate calculation shows the ramification map is an isomorphism in characteristic not two and collapses onto a line in characteristic two. Thus the determinant divisor is smooth irreducible over the open unramified locus, with exact examples and a complete characteristic-two classification. The included checker reproduces the general derivative polynomial and all reported finite examples. No infinite conclusion is based on finite enumeration alone.

value.rationale: The fixed-source normal splitting of the smallest all-quadratic family in the natural toric threefold directly answers the current literature question about generic splitting and first jumping loci. The complete geometric smooth irreducible jumping divisor, multidegree, two exact normal types, and characteristic-two total collapse constitute a natural structural classification beyond routine numerical verification; it explains a characteristic-dependent deformation-theoretic phenomenon.
